A. Watermelon
1 second
256 megabytes

One hot summer day Pete and his friend Billy decided to buy a watermelon. They chose the biggest and the ripest one. The watermelon was so heavy that the boys decided to distribute it as evenly as possible.

They want to divide the watermelon in such a way that each part weighs an even number of kilos, and the parts are not necessarily equal. Help the boys and determine if they can do that.

Input

The first line contains an integer w (1 ≤ w ≤ 100) — the weight of the watermelon.

Output

Print YES, if the boys can divide the watermelon, and NO otherwise.

Examples
8
YES
brute force, math
